What Takings does

A clearer view of your reselling.

Everything is designed around one question: after the costs, what did you actually make?

True profit tracking

See what you actually made after purchase cost, marketplace fees, postage, packaging and other expenses.

Marketplace sales

Bring sales from the marketplaces you use into one place as supported integrations become available.

Goals

Set monthly profit targets and see whether you are on pace and what you need to make next.

Insights

Understand which marketplaces and sales are actually generating the strongest returns over time.

Threshold monitoring

Track recorded turnover against relevant reporting and registration thresholds with clear contextual guidance.

Private by design

Takings is designed around local-first financial tracking so you remain in control of your recorded data.

Privacy

Built around your control.

Takings is a financial tracking app for online resellers. The app is being designed as a local-first application, with users remaining in control of their recorded financial information.

  • Takings does not sell personal information.
  • Marketplace passwords will never be collected by Takings.
  • Official OAuth/API authentication will be used where marketplace integrations are available.
  • Contact details may be provided voluntarily when contacting Takings support.

Last updated: September 2026

Terms

Clear tools, not professional advice.

Takings provides financial tracking and informational tools for resellers. It does not provide tax, accounting, financial or legal advice.

  • Profit and threshold calculations depend on information supplied or imported by the user.
  • Users remain responsible for checking the accuracy and completeness of their records.
  • Marketplace integrations are subject to third-party availability and approval.
  • Takings is not responsible for changes, interruptions or restrictions affecting third-party marketplaces or APIs.
